controls: The profile is admitted only for the five named wikis and the exact 2048-bucket layout.
Production keeps effective source concurrency at one.
The 6 GiB cgroup ceiling and resource governor remain fail-closed.
Candidate processing is publication-invisible until receipt validation and publication preflight pass.
Failures retain the current public generation and return work to bounded retry or quarantine.
The compatibility repair executes sequentially to avoid correlated memory and NFS pressure.

qualification_scope.reason: This is a controlled workload-profile admission based on recorded production peaks and stricter partitioning, not a rewrite of the legacy aggregation benchmark matrix.
qualification_scope.first_run_requirement: Review the resulting candidate resource receipt before publication; preflight remains mandatory.
